versions.changelog:
news-telegram-push v2.0.4

- Tightened and clarified output formatting: each headline must now be on the same line as its number, with the "Read more" link indented on the line below.
- Added explicit prohibition of summaries, commentary, and source labels in all sections.
- Updated the required numbering and indentation style for news items for greater clarity and Telegram compatibility.
- Minor editorial refinements to documentation for consistency and precision.

news-telegram-push v2.0.3

- Clarified and tightened output formatting requirements for each section, with explicit instructions for numbering, layout, and structure.
- Mandated strict two-line format per news item: headline and "Read more: full_link".
- Explicitly prohibited the use of bullets, alternative list styles, emojis, or summaries in output.
- Strengthened guidance that only three sections must be output, each containing exactly 10 consecutively numbered items.
- Improved instructions to prevent accidental deviation from the required Telegram-ready output style.

- Output format changed: Each section's news items are now numbered 1–10.
- Numbered format replaces previous unnumbered headlines in each category section.
- Output structure instructions in SKILL.md updated to specify exact numbering and indentation.
- No other logic or rule changes.

**Updated category structure and output formatting for higher clarity and relevance:**

- News categories reduced to three: Industry News, Financial News, and Global Political News (was previously six).
- Each push now delivers exactly 10 headlines per category (30 items total).
- Output format simplified: only headline and "Read more" link per item; no source names, summaries, or labels.
- Category scope clarified (e.g., Industry News now includes FX/CFD, Crypto, Prediction Markets, Retail Trading App Technology).
- Deduplication and inclusion rules are more strictly defined for each category and push timing.
- Preferred sources, exclusions, and ranking logic updated to further enhance content quality and audience value.

Version 2.0.0 – Major update expanding news coverage and output

- Now outputs 10 headlines per category, for 6 categories (30 items per push vs. previous 10).
- Each category (Industry News, Crypto, Prediction Markets, Retail Trading App Tech, Financial News, Global Political News) has its own top 10 list per push.
- Revised selection and enforcement rules to match expanded coverage.
- Clarified deduplication and sourcing guidelines.
- Removed _meta.json file.

news-telegram-push 1.0.2 changelog:

- Updated news gathering method: now uses tavily or firecrawl as primary tools for fetching news, with browser/tool as fallback.
- Clarified and expanded the list of supported tools and their usage guidelines.
- Adjusted documentation to reflect new tooling and improved extraction process for JS-heavy sites.
- No changes to selection logic or output format.

- Added tool usage instructions: Use browser automation (not web_fetch) with specific settings for news extraction from major sites.
- Specified extractMode as "text" and recommended maxChars between 8000–12000 for thorough extraction.
- Clarified that news sites require JavaScript rendering, thus use of the browser tool is preferred.
- No changes to news selection, sourcing, or deduplication rules.

- Initial release of the news-telegram-push skill.
- Curates and sends twice-daily (7:00 AM & 7:00 PM) English news updates to Telegram.
- Covers top 10 stories across Industry News, FX/CFD, Crypto, Prediction Markets, Retail Trading App Technology, Financial News, and Global Political News.
- Enforces strict deduplication, trusted-source filtering, and high-quality selection rules.
- Delivers each push in a standardized, Telegram-ready format with clear itemization and sourcing.
